description: Run a query against AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews) and return each model's answer along with the sources it cited. Priced per AI surface queried. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

country.description: Optional ISO-2 country to measure from, e.g. "gb". Omit for each surface's default. Gemini has no country setting and ignores it.

fullSweep.description: Query all five AI surfaces (adds claude and google_ai_overview) for full cross-surface coverage, at a higher cost. Ignored when models is given.

language.description: Optional ISO-2 language for google_ai_overview and chatgpt_app, which read in it. Needs country; defaults to the country's main language.

models.description: AI surfaces to query, each billed separately; pass a subset when the user names surfaces or wants a lower cost. Omit for the defaults (chatgpt, perplexity, gemini); fullSweep queries all five. google_ai_overview accepts queries up to 700 characters, the others 2000. chatgpt_app (answers captured from the ChatGPT app itself) is opt-in and slower: a single call waits 30 s for it, then returns the OpenAI API answer in its place, labelled in measurement.

query.description: The concise AI-search/market-research query to run against the selected models.

name: cite42_search
